en.headline: Baidu opens free robotaxi public trials in Tung Chung next week
en.dek: Apollo Go vehicles will run a 5.1-kilometre loop from Yat Tung Estate for two weeks starting 21 October, with ride vouchers distributed through the Islands District Council.
body: Baidu’s Apollo Go robotaxi service will hold Hong Kong’s first community public trial of autonomous vehicles in Tung Chung for 14 days from 21 October to 3 November, the Transport Department said in a paper to the Islands District Council.

Vehicles will operate daily from 2pm to 6pm on a fixed loop starting at Yat Tung Estate Car Park No. 1, via Chung Yan Road, Yu Tung Road and Yi Tung Road to the Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung Hotel, then returning to the same car park. There are no intermediate stops; the full circuit is about 5.1 kilometres and takes roughly 15 minutes. Each vehicle carries at most two passengers and has a backup operator on board.

Six hundred ride tickets are available in total, enough for up to 1,200 people. Most will be distributed through the Islands District Council secretariat to councillors for sharing with residents. Riders must be aged eight or above or at least 1.35 metres tall. Councillors will have a preview day on 20 October.

The department said it supports the programme so residents can experience self-driving firsthand. Baidu has previously conducted trials in several districts, accumulating more than 280,000 kilometres.

zh.headline: 百度蘿蔔快跑下周三起東涌公眾試乘 為期兩周
zh.dek: 自動車每日下午2至6時行走約5.1公里固定路線，由逸東邨出發折返，乘車券經離島區議會派發，每次最多載兩人。
body: 百度旗下自動駕駛平台「蘿蔔快跑」將於10月21日至11月3日在東涌舉行全港首個社區公眾自動駕駛車輛試乘活動，為期14天。運輸署在提交離島區議會的文件中表示支持有關安排。
自動車每日下午2時至6時行走固定路線，由逸東邨一號停車場出發，經松仁路、裕東路及怡東路前往東涌北世茂喜來登酒店後折返同一停車場，中途不設落客點。全程約5.1公里，車程約15分鐘。每車最多載兩名乘客，並有後備操作員跟車。
合共提供600張乘車券，最多可接待1200人，大部分透過離島區議會秘書處派發予議員再分享給居民。參加者須年滿8歲或身高至少1.35米。區議員將於10月20日先試乘。
運輸署表示希望居民可親身體驗自動駕駛。百度早前已在多區進行測試，累計行駛超過28萬公里。
